newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Nike Inc holding steady.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Nike Inc holding steady.

text.p: Nike Inc, buffeted during regular trading hours Tuesday by rumors about lost orders, was holding steady after the bell at its closing price, traders said.
The stock had fallen as low as 63 earlier Tuesday, but recovered to close at 66-3/8, down 1/2 a point for the day. And that was where it was holding in after-hours trading.
"There's nothing out of line," one trader said.
A footwear trade magazine reported rumors that retailers were cutting back on Nike orders. Later Tuesday, Woolworth Corp, which owns Foot Locker, said thhe rumor was untrue.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 32,400, while on Monday it was 1,300. Session two volume was 1,888,874, compared to 10,015,421 on Monday.
